ceteti.p: [Cita+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=10 Exerts-puts effort-strives-causes to happen. ceteti (kri) [citi+ṇe+ti] conceives-infers-considers-thinks. ceteti (kā, kri) [cita + ṇe + ti] Causes to be frightened - to be afraid. ceteti (kā, kri) [citi + ṇe + ti] makes known.

DOP: ceteti, ~ayati pr. 3 sg. [ S. cetayati], forms an idea in the mind; thinks about, is intent upon; has in mind (to); intends, forms an intention (to); strives mentally (for) ; Vin III 19, 38 (tvaṃ āvuso bhagavatā virāgāya dhamme desite sarāgāya ~essasi; Sp 217, 25 : saha rāgena vattamānāya methunadhammāya ~essasi kappessasi pakappessasi etadatthaṃ vāyamissasī ti attho, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr vāyamissatī ti); 113, 30 (ajjhattarūpe ~eti upakkamati muccati āpatti saṅghādisesassa; Sp 524, 20 : mocanassādasampayuttāya cetanāya muccatū ti ~eti); 172, 17 (ime kho samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā dhutā sallekha-vuttino, samaṇo pana Gotamo bāhulliko bāhullāya ~etī ti; Sp 607, 12 : bahulatāya ~eti kappeti pakappeti, kathaṃ hi nāma mayhaṃ ca sāvakānaṃ ca cīvarādibahulabhāvo bhaveyyā ti evaṃ ussukkaṃ āpanno ti adhippāyo, Be, Ce so; Ee bāhullattāya ~eti; Se bāhullatthāya); D I 184, 19 foll. (ahaṃ ce va kho pana ~eyyaṃ abhisaṅkhareyyaṃ imā ca me saññā nirujjheyyuṃ, aññā ca oḷārikā saññā uppajjeyyuṃ, yaṃ nūnāhaṃ na ~eyyaṃ na abhisaṅkhareyyan ti; Sv 373, 14 foll. : ~eyyaṃ abhisaṅkhareyyan ti padadvaye jhānaṃ samāpajjanto ~eti nāma punappuna kappetī ti attho, uparisamāpatti-atthāya nikantiṃ kurumāno abhisaṅkharoti nāma); M III 21, 29 (asappuriso attavyābādhāya pi ~eti paravyābādhāya pi ~eti; Ps IV 80, 8 : attavyābādhāya ~etī ti … dasa akusalakammapathe samādāya vattissāmī ti evaṃ attano dukkhatthāya cinteti); S I 121, 17* (sāvako te mahāvīra maraṇaṃ … ākaṅkhati ~ayati); II 65, 15 (yaṃ ca kho bhikkhave ~eti yaṃ ca pakappeti yaṃ ca anuseti ārammaṇaṃ etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā); IV 201, 15 (sace so bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano āyatipunabbhavāya ~eti); A I 192, 22 (na kho panāhaṃ kassaci pāpaṃ ~emi); IV 118, 15 (yasmiṃ samaye ariyasāvako agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāya ~eti; Mp IV 59, 21 : pabbajissāmī ti cinteti); Sn 973 (janavāda-dhammāya na ~ayeyya; Pj II 574, 15 : cetanaṃ na uppādeyya); Vv 84:40 (parūpaghātāya na ~ayeyya); Th 1204 (na ve aggi ~ayati ahaṃ bālaṃ ḍahāmi ti; Th-a III 179, 23 foll. : evaṃ na aggi abhisañceteti nāpi ḍahanāya payogaṃ parakkamaṃ karoti); Ja III 146, 16* (rakkhāya me tvaṃ vihito nu s’ ajja udāhu me ~ayase vadhāya, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se vāyamase); Paṭis II 131, 38 (taṃ dhammaṃ ~ayatī ti ceto); Peṭ 222, 10 (ye puna-bbhavaṃ na icchanti na ~ayissanti na ca patthayissanti); Spk II 380, 32 (vedanā vedeti cetanā ~eti saññā sañjānātī ti); Ud-a 431, 31 (na hi khīṇāsavā aparikkhīṇe āyusaṅkhāre paresaṃ apavādādibhayena parinibbānāya ~enti ghaṭanti vāyamanti); As 111, 7 (~ayatī ti cetanā); Sadd 538, 33 (cita sañcetane: ~eti ~ayati); — part.pr. ( a ) cetenta, mfn. , Sp 524, 21 ; Sv 373, 21 ; ( b ) cetaya(t), mfn. , Paṭis I 108, 19 (nekkhammekattaṃ ~ayato kāmacchandato cittaṃ vivaṭṭatī ti); — neg. acetaya(t), mfn. , D I 184, 23 ; ( c ) cetayanta, mfn. , Kv 343, 28 ; Sp 60, 8 (~ayantam eva hi kammaṃ phusati nācetayantaṃ); — neg. acetayanta, mfn. , Kv 343, 24 ; ( d ) cetayamāna, mfn. , D I 184, 18 (~ayamānassa me pāpiyo acetayamānassa me seyyo); Ps I 276, 13 (na kevalaṃ phasso va uppajjati tena saddhiṃ tad eva ārammanaṃ anubhavamānā vedanā uppajjati sañjānamānā saññā pi ~ayamānā cetanā pi vijānamānaṃ viññāṇaṃ pi uppajjati); It-a II 83, 8 (saṃsāre ādīnavaṃ disvā pabbajjāya ~ayamāno); — neg. acetayamāna, mfn. , D I 184, 19 ; ( e ) cetayāna, mfn. [ ts ], having sense, having understanding, reasonable ; Ja V 339, 21* (kā nu pāsena baddhassa gati aññā mahānasā sā kathaṃ ~ayānassa muttassa tava ruccati; 341, 16´ : tava pana ~ayānassa sacetanassa paññāvato muttassa kathaṃ ruccati); — aor. 3 sg. cetayī̆, Vin V 218, 21 (na cāpi so parammaraṇāya ~ayi); Ap 562, 12 (corappapātaṃ netvāna pabbataṃ ~ayī vadhaṃ); 1 sg. acetayiṃ, Pv 6:6 (sapattī me gabbhinī āsi tassā pāpaṃ acetayiṃ); — absol. ( a ) cecca, Vin III 73, 19 (sañciccā ti jānanto sañjānanto cecca abhivitaritvā vītikkamo; Sp 437, 8 : ceccā ti vadhakacetanāvasena ~etvā pakappetvā); Vin-vn 999; Sadd 539, 8 (ceccā ti abhivitaritvā ti attho); — neg. acecca, Vin II 91, 31 ; ( b ) cetetvā, Mp V 1, 16 (na cetanāya karaṇīyan ti na ~etvā kappetvā pakappetvā kātabbaṃ); Vv-a 146, 23 ; Sadd 539, 3 ; — neg. acetetvā, Sp 463, 10 ; ( c ) cetayitvā, A III 415, 7 (cetanāhaṃ bhikkhave kammaṃ vadāmi, ~ayitvā kammaṃ karoti kāyena vācāya manasā); Mil 61, 25 (ekacco puggalo akusalaṃ kammaṃ cetanāya ~ayitvā); Sadd 539, 4 ; — pp ( a ) cetayita , mfn. and n. , ( mfn. ) formed (as an idea) in the mind; intended ; ( n. ) forming an idea; an intention ; A V 187, 3 foll. (sā kho pan’ esā diṭṭhi bhūtā saṅkhatā ~ā paṭiccasamuppannā, yaṃ kho pana kiñci bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ ~aṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ tad aniccaṃ; Mp V 63, 8 : ~ā ti kappitā); Peṭ 26, 4 (yaṃ ~aṃ pakappitaṃ); 218, 6 foll. (yaṃ ~aṃ kāyavācasikānaṃ kammānaṃ, kiṃkaraṇā, ~aṃ hi cetanā manokammā ti vuccate, so read with Ñāṇamoli, 1964, p. 294 ? eds yaṃ vā cetasikaṃ kāyikaṃ cetasikaṃ kammaṃ kiṃkāraṇā, cetasikā hi cetanā manokammā ti vuccate); Sadd 539, 7 (~an ti cetanākāro); — ~-tta, n. , intention; forming an idea ; Dhs 281 (yā tasmiṃ samaye tajjā manoviññāṇadhātu samphassajā cetanā sañcetanā ~-ttaṃ ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetanā hoti); Sv 998, 1 (dānaṃ ārabbha dānādhikicca yā uppajjati cetanā sañcetanā ~-ttaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati dānamayo puññābhisaṅkhāro); — ~-lakkhaṇa, mfn. , of which the distinguishing mark is forming an idea or intention ; Mil 62, 5 (~-lakkhaṇā cetanā abhisaṅkharaṇalakkhaṇā cā ti); Spk II 292, 31 (~-lakkhaṇassa saṅkhārassa); As 111, 8 ([cetanā] ~-lakkhaṇā, cetanābhāvalakkhaṇā ti attho); — pp ( b ) cetita , mfn. , formed (as an idea) in the mind ; Peṭ 220, 5 (evaṃ saṅkhārā ~ā pakappitā ca ārammaṇabhūtā honti); Ps II 361, 28 (saṅkhato ti ~o kappito pakappito …); III 13, 27 (abhisañcetayitan ti ~aṃ pakappitaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se cetayitaṃ) ≠ Mp V 84, 27 ( Ce, Ee, Se ~aṃ kappitaṃ; Be cetayitaṃ kappayitam); — fpp ( a ) cetabba , mfn. ,, ( b ) ceteyya , mfn. , — ~-rūpa, ( mf ) n. , (what is) very much to be thought of or held in mind ; Ja IV 157, 15* (cetabbarūpaṃ cetesi, Ce so; Ee wr cetasi; Be ceteyyarūpaṃ; Se cetayarūpaṃ; 157, 17´ foll. : ñātīsu muducittatāya cintento cintetabba-yuttakam eva cintesi); — see also cetāpeti.
NCP: pr. 3 sg. forms an idea in the mind; thinks about, is intent upon; has in mind (to); intends, forms an intention (to); strives mentally (for)
